description: Read everything that shapes what reaches this person: delivery schedule, length, technicality, depth, stance and tone, stated interests and no-go topics, the profile the system has learned about them, the per-topic preferences built from their feedback (affinity, muted, followed themes) and the specific stories they pinned with "follow" (every development of those gets reported). This is the full picture of their news filter — read it before changing anything.
name: get_information_diet
title: Read the information diet
